caption: the black-box street racing trilogy in one row - the blacklist, the underground scene and carbon's canyon duels.
about: This row carries the three black-box street racers that defined the series' golden run. Need for Speed: Most Wanted (2005) built the blacklist - fifteen rivals, heat levels, pursuit tech and the iconic bmw m3 gtr. Need for Speed: Underground (2003) is the tuner scene at its purest - night cities, deep visual customization and drag races measured in perfect shifts. Need for Speed: Carbon (2006) closed the era with canyon duels and crew-based territory wars.

All three windows builds are delisted - ea retired the classics when the series moved to frostbite - so the archive route is the way back in. The blacklist pursuit law still stands as the series' best remembered loop, and the 2005 game carries its own modpack on this site's mods shelf: most wanted redux v3.
